manifest.summary: Codename 'Phosphor'. Thirteen small modules - eight games, five generative experiments - in one cabinet, all in a single static/index.html using Canvas 2D and Web Audio with no libraries. The same page also runs as a standalone claude.ai Artifact; the backend exists only for the two things a browser tab cannot do alone.

features.name: Standing Wave (game)
features.description: Steer and survive on a live cymatics field driven by the FFT of your MP3; ride the dark nodal lines. Needs a track.

features.name: Aphelion (game)
features.description: Gravity slingshot. Drag to aim; the predicted trajectory uses the same integrator the probe flies and turns cyan when the shot will reach the beacon.

features.name: Zero Beat (game)
features.description: Match a target waveform harmonic by harmonic; the monitor tone detunes with your error so a match is an audible unison.

features.name: Hearsay (game)
features.description: Five crew, one wiped log, gossip that spreads between NPCs. Uses Jan for phrasing only - the case logic is deterministic JS, so it is fully winnable with Jan off.

features.name: Escapement (game)
features.description: One button. Hold to catch the ring above, release at the top of the arc. A real pendulum constraint - the rope only pulls.

features.name: Waveguide (game)
features.description: Rotate amber mirrors so the beam lights every receiver. Splitters and walls are fixed scenery. Levels are built then verified by tracing the intended solution before shipping.

features.name: Downbeat (game)
features.description: One-button rhythm runner; the track is onset-analysed up front and the runner's position is driven off the audio clock so you jump on the beat. Needs a track.

features.name: Physarum (experiment)
features.description: Slime-mould transport networks: thousands of agents sense and deposit a trail; sensor angle and reach decide veins vs spirals vs lace. Deposit rate rides the bass with a track loaded.

features.name: Gray-Scott (experiment)
features.description: Reaction-diffusion. Feed and kill are the whole system; a thousandth either way changes the species. Paint with the pointer.

features.name: Divergence (experiment)
features.description: An ensemble of double pendulums released a millionth of a radian apart; they agree for ~10 s then never again. Readout tracks the spread.

features.name: Waterfall (experiment)
features.description: Your track as a scrolling log-frequency spectrogram with a live waveform scope above it. Needs a track.

services: Jan / llama.cpp @ http://127.0.0.1:1337/v1 (optional; Hearsay falls back to a built-in template brain when Jan is off or the backend is absent). Model id is auto-detected from whatever Jan currently has loaded.
manifest.fullscreen: Press F or the Full button. Any non-menu screen posts postMessage({forge:'chrome',hidden:true}) so the hub hides its sidebar, and hands it back on the menu.
known_gaps: Not visually verified - no screenshot capability in the agent sandbox and the Chrome extension is not connected. Layout, feel and balance are unconfirmed; Downbeat's jump/gravity constants are reasoned, not playtested.

Static checks that DO pass: tools/smoke.js (every module, 3000 frames, random input), tools/wg_sweep.js (30,000 Waveguide boards, zero unsolvable), JS syntax, element-id cross-check, backend endpoint round-trips.
